prompts.J02-one-bottom: One ivory wooden artist's mannequin on the right faces one shallow cobalt dish on a walnut table. prompts.J02-one-rim: One ivory wooden artist's mannequin on the left faces one shallow cobalt dish on a walnut table. The mannequin rests one fingertip on the upper rim. prompts.J01-one-wear: One ivory wooden artist's mannequin stands on the left behind a walnut jewelry counter, facing the camera. A single long strand of garnet beads loops once around its neck. Its neck, both hands and the entire strand are in frame. Soft window light.
prompts.J01-one-hold: One ivory wooden artist's mannequin stands on the right behind a walnut jewelry counter, facing the camera. It holds the loose end of a long strand of garnet beads between its fingertips, its own bare wooden neck fully visible. Its neck, both hands and the entire strand are in frame. Soft window light.
prompts.J01-two-strands: Two ivory wooden artist's mannequins stand side by side behind a walnut jewelry counter, facing the camera. One strand of garnet beads loops once around the left mannequin's neck. The right mannequin holds a second, separate strand of garnet beads between its fingertips, its own bare wooden neck fully visible. Both necks, both hands and both strands are in frame. Soft window light.
